# phare_integration_pushover (Resource)

Manages a Pushover integration in Phare, sending alerts as Pushover notifications. Integrations belong to the organization and are used by alert rules to send notifications. [See docs](https://docs.phare.io/integrations/pushover).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "pushover_user_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "pushover_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "phare_integration_pushover" "phones" {
  name = "Pushover"

  settings = {
    user_key = var.pushover_user_key
    api_key  = var.pushover_api_key
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Integration name, must be unique across all the integrations of the organization
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the Pushover integration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Date of creation
- `id` (Number) Integration ID
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the integration is paused, integrations can only be paused from the control panel
- `updated_at` (String) Date of last update

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Pushover application API token (30 characters). The API never returns this value, it is kept from the Terraform state and changes made outside of Terraform are not detected.
- `user_key` (String, Sensitive) Pushover user or group key (30 characters). The API never returns this value, it is kept from the Terraform state and changes made outside of Terraform are not detected.
